description: Stores a file of your own (PNG, JPEG or WebP image, MP4 or MOV video, MP3 or WAV audio) and returns a link and an id, either one for image_urls, video_urls or audio_urls (and create_character, edit_video). Three ways in: data — the file as base64 here (up to 20 MB); prepare — a signed link to PUT the file to yourself, with a ready curl command (videos up to 50 MB; best for big files, no base64 in the chat); url — we fetch a public link. Kept 48 hours, then deleted.

bytes.description: mode prepare: the file's exact size in bytes (for example: wc -c < file). The link takes exactly this many.

content_type.description: mode prepare: the file's type, for example image/png, video/mp4, audio/mpeg. Other modes read the type from the file itself.

data.description: mode data: the file, base64-encoded (a data: URL works too).

filename.description: The file's name; in mode prepare its extension gives the type when content_type is left out.

mode.description: How the file comes. data (default): base64 here, up to 20 MB. prepare: a signed link you PUT the file to yourself (a ready curl command comes back): videos up to 50 MB, images 20 MB, audio 15 MB — best for big files and whenever you have a shell, no base64. url: we fetch a public https link ourselves.

url.description: mode url: a public https link to the file itself.

name: upload_media
title: Upload media
